name: obfuscatorio-deobf-6tools-llm
description: javascript-obfuscator (obfuscator.io) の7変換複合を、決定論スクリプト6本 + LLM 1回で解除する

scripts.gen-corpus: for d in destring dedead decff deselfdefend dedebug decompact; do (cd scripts/$d && node gen-corpus.js) || exit 1; done
scripts.verify: for d in destring dedead decff deselfdefend dedebug decompact; do (cd scripts/$d && node verify.js) || exit 1; done
